description: The gdal_translate_fuzzer harness terminated with EXIT_CODE:1 when run against the supplied input, but the captured output contains no AddressSanitizer/UBSan diagnostics and no stack frames. Without a sanitizer report, the crash type, faulting function, source location, and access shape (READ/WRITE, size) cannot be determined from this log. The target is GDAL's gdal_translate code path as exercised by the OSS-Fuzz gdal_translate_fuzzer harness; reproduction under a sanitizer-instrumented build is required to obtain an actionable trace.
title: Heap-buffer-overflow in gdal
